eyecross.chat.need_more: Throw one more Eye of Ender to compute the intersection.

eyecross.chat.high_residual: Residuals are large; consider throwing one more eye.
eyecross.chat.parallel: These trails are nearly parallel and cannot intersect. Move a good distance away (in a different direction) and throw again.
eyecross.chat.trail_too_short: Trail too short (the eye broke close by); ignored. Throw again.
eyecross.chat.trail_degenerate: Degenerate trail; could not fit a line. Throw again.
eyecross.chat.need_two: At least 2 trails are needed to compute an intersection.
eyecross.help.header: Eye Cross — locate a stronghold from Eye of Ender trails
eyecross.help.step1: 1. Throw an Eye of Ender; its trail is recorded automatically when it breaks or drops.
eyecross.help.step2: 2. Move a good distance away, ideally so the second throw points in a different direction.
eyecross.help.step3: 3. With 2 or more trails the stronghold is computed: the chat shows a clickable coordinate, the HUD keeps it on screen, and a beacon-like beam marks the spot in the world.
eyecross.help.more: More throws improve accuracy (the latest %s trails are kept).
